rows.title: Here’s how much Trump’s campaign has been hurt by the pandemic
rows.standfirst: Changes in GDP and jobs in the election year are major factors, so it’s likely that if last year’s economic trends had been uninterrupted by the pandemic, Trump could have been tough to beat.

rows.title: Housing flips the recession script: Prices will keep rising for up to a year, but here’s how the party will end
rows.standfirst: Housing prices have defied the COVID economy by rising at a startling clip. But a huge buildup in delinquencies foreshadows the flood to come.

rows.title: The biggest economic threat facing the next administration: A weak dollar
rows.standfirst: By pulling hard on the stimulus lever, will the Fed push another set macro forces in motion that go in the wrong direction, undermining growth and hammering asset prices?

rows.title: The President doesn’t actually impact the economy that much
rows.standfirst: The findings from a 2016 study are highly relevant to this year’s election.
